questions.question: Which mammal is capable of true powered flight?
questions.hint: Bats are the only mammals capable of sustained powered flight. Other 'flying' mammals only glide.

questions.question: Which layer of Earth's atmosphere contains the ozone layer?
questions.hint: The ozone layer absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

questions.question: Which film became the first non-English language movie to win the Academy Award for Best Picture?
questions.hint: Parasite (2019) made Oscar history by winning Best Picture.

questions.question: In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what is Thor's hammer called?
questions.hint: Mjölnir is Thor's enchanted hammer, forged by the dwarves of Nidavellir.

questions.question: Which document begins with the words "We the People"?
questions.hint: The famous opening phrase introduces the Preamble to the U.S. Constitution.

questions.question: Which organization awards the Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.hint: Unlike the other Nobel Prizes, the Peace Prize is awarded in Norway.

questions.question: Which wall divided East and West Berlin until 1989?
questions.hint: The Berlin Wall stood from 1961 until its fall in 1989, symbolizing the Cold War.

questions.question: Which civilization developed one of the earliest known writing systems called cuneiform?
questions.hint: Cuneiform originated in ancient Mesopotamia over 5,000 years ago.

questions.question: Which country hosted the 2016 Summer Olympics?
questions.hint: Rio de Janeiro became the first South American city to host the Summer Olympics.

questions.question: How many rings are displayed on the Olympic flag?
questions.hint: The five rings represent the unity of the inhabited continents through sport.

questions.question: Which country has the world's largest population by current estimates?
questions.hint: India surpassed China as the world's most populous country in 2023.

questions.question: Which sea separates Europe from Africa?
questions.hint: The Mediterranean Sea lies between southern Europe and northern Africa.

questions.question: Which scientist developed the theory of general relativity?
questions.hint: General relativity describes gravity as the curvature of spacetime.

questions.question: Which element has the chemical symbol "Fe"?
questions.hint: "Fe" comes from the Latin word Ferrum, meaning iron.

questions.question: Which country is the birthplace of the tango dance?
questions.hint: Tango originated in Buenos Aires during the late 19th century.

questions.question: Which language has the largest number of native speakers worldwide?
questions.hint: Mandarin Chinese has the highest number of native speakers globally.

questions.question: Which is the tallest species of animal on Earth?
questions.hint: Adult male giraffes can grow up to about 5.5–6 meters (18–20 feet) tall.

questions.question: Which African country has Cairo as its capital?
questions.hint: Cairo is one of Africa's largest cities and the capital of Egypt.

questions.question: What is the hardest naturally occurring mineral on Earth?
questions.hint: Diamond ranks 10 on the Mohs hardness scale, making it the hardest natural mineral.

questions.question: Which ship famously sank after striking an iceberg in 1912?
questions.hint: The Titanic sank during its maiden voyage in the North Atlantic on April 15, 1912.
